external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.source: For damp patches after rain, tell us where water appears and whether the affected wall connects to a roof, doorway or outdoor tiled area. We inspect accessible surfaces and adjoining junctions before agreeing base preparation and a selected protective system. The written scope confirms the included areas, materials and finish; the visible patch alone does not identify its source.
external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.target: 雨后潮湿斑块，请说明渗水位置，以及墙面是否接屋顶、门口或户外铺砖区。我们检查可接触表面及相邻交接，再确认基层准备和防护系统。书面范围明确区域、材料和饰面；仅凭可见斑块无法判断水源。

external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.source: Damp staining may appear away from the original water-entry point. Tell us whether it follows rain, particular wind conditions or constant moisture, and whether the wall adjoins a roof, doorway or tiled outdoor area. External wall damp diagnosis starts with accessible surfaces and water ingress at junctions. Previous coatings, cracks, sealants and finish condition affect whether a protective treatment is suitable; covering the visible patch alone may leave the source unresolved.
external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.target: 潮湿水渍可能偏离最初进水点。请说明是否在下雨、特定风向或持续潮湿时出现，以及墙面是否邻接屋顶、门口或户外砖面。调查从可接触表面及交接进水开始。旧涂层、裂缝、密封和饰面状况影响防护适用性；仅覆盖斑块可能留下水源问题。

external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.source: Accessible edges and corners with a defined repair boundary
external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.target: 明确可接触边缘、转角及维修边界

external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.source: We define the work area, surface preparation and connections to surrounding finishes in your quote. We arrange access before assessing elevated or concealed areas and identify any separate investigation or trade work. Below-ground structures, retaining walls and structural repairs require their own scope. We discuss the expected colour and texture match before treating the wall.
external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.target: 我们在报价中明确施工区、基层处理及与周边饰面的衔接。高处或隐蔽区域先安排通行，再进行评估，并列明需要的独立调查或其他工种。地下构造、挡土墙及结构维修需单独明确范围；墙面处理前会沟通预期颜色与纹理匹配效果。

external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.source: Tell us whether dampness follows rain or wind, and which roof, doorway or tiled area meets the wall. Safe ground-level photos are optional.
external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.target: 说明潮湿是否随雨或风出现，以及相接的屋顶、门口或瓷砖区。地面安全照片为选填。

external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.target: 准备前评估通行、涂层兼容性及维修边界。

external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.source: We assess the wall material, accessible water-entry details and whether the selected treatment will remain exposed or be covered. Polymer-modified cementitious coatings and other membranes have product-specific movement and water-pressure limits. A general wet-area membrane is not automatically suitable for negative-side pressure. The agreed wall work identifies compatible preparation, detailing and protection; separate window, drainage or structural work needs its own scope.
external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.target: 我们评估墙体材质、可接近的进水节点，以及所选处理层将外露还是被覆盖。聚合物水泥基涂层及其他防水膜，均有具体产品的变形与水压适用条件。普通湿区防水膜不自动适合背水面水压。约定的墙体工作需明确相容的基层处理、节点与保护；独立窗体、排水或结构工程另行确定范围。

external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.source: If an inside wall becomes damp only when rain blows towards it, record the wall face, nearby window or balcony and the first place moisture appears. Water at a window edge can come from several adjoining details; it does not by itself confirm a failed window seal or wall membrane. We assess accessible exterior wall edges, corners and connected surfaces for the waterproofing scope.
external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.target: 如果只有雨被风吹向墙面时室内才受潮，请记录墙面朝向、附近窗户或阳台，以及最先出现水迹的位置。窗边进水可能与多个相邻节点有关，不能据此直接认定窗密封或墙体防水层失效。我们评估可安全接近的外墙边缘、转角及连接表面，明确防水工作范围。

external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.source: The repair needs a sound base and compatible adjoining finishes. A confirmed local junction defect may suit a limited repair; widespread cracking or water arriving from another building element needs that source addressed first. Window-unit repairs, glazing and separate roof or drainage work need their own assessment and scope.
external-wall-waterproofing-adelaide.htm.target: 修复需要稳固基层，并与相邻饰面兼容。确认的局部节点缺陷可考虑小范围处理；大范围开裂或水从其他建筑部位进入，则应先处理相应来源。窗体维修、玻璃工程及独立屋顶或排水工程需分别评估并明确范围。
